summary: Frontend-only regression test for (1) bottom-tab back arrows returning to Dashboard and (2) Stage 6 Bundle Set Report export flow. All 7 frontend checks PASSED. Dashboard has NO back arrow; Inventory/Dealers/Claims/Borrowers(Contacts)/More(Vault) all expose testID 'back-btn' and navigate to '/' (Dashboard) when tapped. Opening a bundle's tool detail screen, opening the kebab (tool-menu-btn) and tapping Export options shows the Export PDF picker; for a bundle the second card is titled 'Set Report' (testID pick-pdf-standard) with the expected description; tapping it triggers a window.confirm 'Include expansion items?' dialog with no JS crash, matching the spec. No backend issues investigated (per request).
critical_code_review_comments: Code review: dealers.tsx / claims.tsx / borrowers.tsx / more.tsx / inventory.tsx all pass `onBack={() => (router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)'))}` to IndustrialBanner — correct pattern. Dashboard ((tabs)/index.tsx) intentionally omits onBack — verified visually no back-btn rendered.
tool/[id].tsx line 3240: title switches between 'Set Report' (bundle) and 'Standard Report' (non-bundle) on the same testID pick-pdf-standard — matches spec.
tool/[id].tsx line 885-888: Alert.alert('Include expansion items?', ...) fires before PDF generation when tool.is_bundle is true — verified by intercepting the web dialog event.

context_for_next_testing_agent: When testing TouchableOpacity/Pressable in this Expo web preview, mouse.down/up works for most buttons but the tool-menu-btn ellipsis required PointerEvent dispatched via page.evaluate to fire (likely due to React Native Web's responder system on icon-only buttons). Use the JS pointerdown/pointerup/click dispatch pattern when a tap doesn't register. Web shows React Native Alert.alert as window.confirm — register a page.on('dialog') handler to capture the prompt.
